posts.title: Forgejo on Railway with 2FA
posts.description: Enabling 2FA broke my Git pushes over HTTPS. Here's the full debugging story, from broken credential tokens to Railway's TCP proxy, ending with a one-line fix in my SSH config.

posts.title: Friendship ended with `Panic(0x1)`, now `BrokenInvariantError` is my best friend
posts.description: ripfuzz now reports broken invariants with a dedicated custom error instead of `assert` panics. The revert data carries the id and description, no cheatcode call, no magic address, and a caught revert finally counts as handled.

posts.title: Value deltas for the max search
posts.description: `ripfuzz max` used to rank sequences by their final value. Exploit ladders dump first, so I now measure value() after every call and keep the dip.
